crossRefs.note: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
Cast away from you all your transgressions, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new…
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is…
You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down…
For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a…
Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you…
Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

parallels.note: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

translations.web: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
translations.bsb: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is known by its fruit.
translations.kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
translations.asv: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by its fruit.
